Definition: from G4862 and a derivative of G5453; grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to:--planted together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says if we have been planted together in the likeness of Christ's death, we shall also be in the likeness of His resurrection. Being planted together with Him means my death and my rising are both His, and the same ground that holds the seed holds the promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that I was planted with Christ in His death so that I will rise with Him, and I believe nothing planted in Him is ever lost.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
